subject.title: fix(qwen): correct Token Plan catalog limits and input modalities

question: Should OpenClaw require China-endpoint validation before changing a catalog shared by China and Global Token Plan users, or accept the Global-only evidence as sufficient for both regions?
rationale: The implementation can be mechanically rebased, but the acceptable regional compatibility guarantee is a maintainer-owned provider contract decision rather than something CI or the contributor’s Global-only transcript can settle.

options.title: Require China proof or separate catalogs
options.body: Hold the shared metadata change until China live output validates it, or split the catalog by endpoint so the proven Global values can land without changing China behavior.

options.title: Accept shared regional parity
options.body: Merge after rebase while explicitly accepting that China endpoint parity is inferred rather than demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Require China proof or separate catalogs
recommendation.body: Hold the shared metadata change until China live output validates it, or split the catalog by endpoint so the proven Global values can land without changing China behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only identified participant with direct knowledge of the live probes and can supply the missing endpoint evidence or narrow the branch.
